thread:
alina: Heads-up: proposing a "Fallback Explainability" compact panel for rollouts. Main ask: three-line answer "why it fell back", link to audit, sandbox replay.
berto: Nice. Must show matched rule id, signal snapshot (p95, error_rate, quota_left) and a tiny sparkline.
sam: Important: default hide any raw request context. Admins can opt-in to expose sanitized context.
ci-bot: ci-bot: build 0.26.3 deployed to staging :white_check_mark:
alina: UI sketch: header with decision summary, trigger table (signal/value/threshold/margin), operator overrides list (with revert), small cost-delta widget, "Replay (dry-run)" button.
berto: Replay should be non-destructive: run decision logic against recorded context, return simulated route + est. cost. No live model calls.
ops-morgan: How to handle quota-based fallbacks? If quota exhausted, default route to cheaper model but allow per-rollout policy to hard reject. Need precedence in UI.
alina: Proposed precedence shown: operator override > maintenance > quota-fallback > perf-trigger > error-trigger > reject. We'll make it editable per rollout.
sam: Add hysteresis: cooldown timer when rule triggers, show "cooldown remaining" and reason to avoid flip-flop.
berto: Retention: 90 days default for decision snapshots, org-configurable. Exports should be CSV/JSON for audits.
alina: Follow-ups: API contract for /rollouts/{id}/decisions, admin toggle for exposing context, mock screenshots, small ops playbook for revert flow. Tag me for review.
ops-morgan: Thanks, ping me for mock sign-off.
ci-bot: ci-bot: created ticket ENG-1428 for API contract
